description.text: The road runs down between hedges toward the square, and there is nobody on it. A cat crosses ahead of you, unhurried, and vanishes under a gate.

The road runs down between high hedges toward the village square. Cart ruts, hoof-cut mud dried hard, and a stone trough at the bend with a slick of green water in it. From here you can hear the well chain and somebody hammering, a long way off.
The road runs down between high hedges toward the village square, and the day's traffic has left it churned. Smells of bread from somewhere west, and woodsmoke from everywhere.

options.text: Walk back up to the crossroads
Talk to Mabel and her linen basket
Talk to Dov, running an errand
Walk on to the village square
